name: sendkuy
description: Send WhatsApp, SMS and email, verify OTP codes and run campaigns with SendKuy.
long_description: Let Claude send WhatsApp, SMS and email through your SendKuy account: alerts, daily summaries, order notifications and OTP codes, plus campaigns you prepared in the SendKuy dashboard. Tools follow the scopes of your API key, so a read-only key never sees a tool that sends.

api_key.title: SendKuy API key
api_key.description: Create a key at https://app.sendkuy.com/user/api with the scopes your assistant needs, plus account:read.
